summary: This joint resolution blocks the Department of Energy's December 2024 rule that sets new energy conservation standards for walk-in coolers and freezers, so the rule has no legal effect.

scores.thoughts: The bill is a Congressional Review Act resolution nullifying a specific DOE energy efficiency rule. It contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budgets.
The legislation addresses only the status of an administrative rule on appliance standards and has no tax-related content.
No connection to healthcare policy, coverage, or markets appears in the bill text.

The bill explicitly disapproves and nullifies a Department of Energy energy conservation standard for commercial refrigeration equipment. This directly blocks an environmental/energy-efficiency regulation, aligning with the +1 direction of limiting environmental regulations.
